title: Lead research brief
summary: Builds a short pre-outreach research brief before drafting a message.
problem_solved: Prevents blind outbound messaging and improves relevance.
why_it_worked: It forces source inspection, business context capture, and offer matching before message generation.

title: Website design-to-build handoff brief
summary: Defines content, proof, structure, and anti-template rules before AI-assisted website implementation.
problem_solved: Reduces vague website generation and improves semantic, proof-driven delivery.
why_it_worked: It constrained the design lane before implementation and preserved content hierarchy.

title: LinkedIn comment research workflow
summary: Researches a post and surrounding context before drafting a comment.
problem_solved: Avoids low-context generic comments and improves public credibility.
why_it_worked: The workflow added mandatory source analysis before comment drafting.

title: Zoom to Monday call scoring workflow
summary: Captures a meeting outcome, preserves transcript evidence, and writes scoring outputs into operational records.
problem_solved: Reduces manual follow-up drift after meetings and keeps evidence attached to the record.
why_it_worked: It preserved the chain from meeting event to transcript to scored operational object.

title: AI workspace onboarding workflow
summary: Creates a private AI-ready workspace and delivers access instructions after registration.
problem_solved: Reduces onboarding delay for AI practice and delivery environments.
why_it_worked: It standardized environment creation and turned setup into a repeatable flow.

title: Node-RED operations orchestrator
summary: Coordinates deterministic automation steps and bounded AI-assisted actions inside operational workflows.
problem_solved: Provides a stable orchestration layer across multiple automation tasks.
why_it_worked: It kept deterministic steps explicit while allowing bounded AI assistance where helpful.

title: Source-first before generation
summary: Do not generate comments, outreach, or summaries until the source context has been inspected.
problem_solved: Prevents low-context output and reduces hallucinated assumptions.
why_it_worked: It consistently improved output quality across outreach, content, and delivery tasks.

title: Public-safe demo boundary
summary: Separate reviewed synthetic demo corpora from richer internal test corpora.
problem_solved: Allows public demonstrations without leaking internal or customer data.
why_it_worked: It preserves the product story while keeping sensitive material out of public routes.

title: Portfolio site delivery workflow
summary: Turns proof, architecture, and positioning notes into a structured premium website delivery flow.
problem_solved: Creates a reusable structure for credible technical marketing sites.
why_it_worked: It aligned design, proof, and implementation around a small semantic architecture instead of template output.
